whyItMatters: A package published to the supplemental index can win over the reviewed one for any name the project uses, which is the dependency-confusion path.
actions: Mark internal sources `explicit` so they are only used when a dependency names them, or mirror the public index with a documented policy.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm pyproject.toml no longer carries a Poetry source marked `priority = "supplemental"`, which is searched for every package name.
